reading: Scientists have concluded that a collapsed glacier is the probable cause of devastating floods that recently impacted regions across Nepal and Tibet.
These preliminary investigations highlight a critical issue: the escalating rate of rapidly melting Himalayan ice, a direct consequence of climate change.
The disaster, which precipitated widespread destruction and loss, underscores the profound implications of cryospheric changes in high-mountain environments.
Experts indicate that glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) are becoming more frequent as global temperatures rise, accelerating the ablation of ancient ice masses.
The scale of the damage has been described as catastrophic, with infrastructure severely compromised and communities displaced.
Such events pose significant threats to downstream populations who rely on glacial meltwater but are also highly vulnerable to sudden, immense discharges.
Further research is imperative to accurately model future risks and develop early warning systems for these high-altitude hazards.
The incident serves as a stark reminder of the urgent need for global climate action and regional adaptation strategies.
Understanding the precise mechanisms of glacial collapse and subsequent flood generation is crucial for mitigating future humanitarian crises.
This specific event exemplifies the complex and interconnected ecological ramifications of planetary warming on fragile ecosystems.

vocabulary.definition: Caused (an event or situation, typically one that is bad or undesirable) to happen suddenly, unexpectedly, or prematurely.
The process of loss of surface material from a glacier or snowfield through melting, evaporation, or calving.
Significant and far-reaching consequences or effects that may not be immediately obvious but will have a deep impact.
the basic networks and facilities on which an activity or society depends
the wider, sometimes complicated consequences of an action
Concerned with or seeking to promote human welfare, especially by providing aid and support to people in need.
emphasises the importance or significance of something
relating to the frozen parts of Earth, including glaciers and ice sheets

entries.ja: （通常は悪くて望ましくない出来事や状況を）突然、予期せず、または時期尚早に引き起こした。
entries.ko: (보통 나쁘거나 바람직하지 않은 사건이나 상황이) 갑자기, 예상치 못하게 또는 시기상조로 발생하게 만든.
entries.zh-Hans: 导致（通常是不好或不希望发生的事件或情况）突然、意外或过早地发生。
entries.es: Provocó que (un evento o situación, típicamente uno malo o indeseable) sucediera de repente, inesperada o prematuramente.
entries.pt-BR: Fez com que (um evento ou situação, geralmente ruim ou indesejável) acontecesse de repente, inesperadamente ou antes da hora.

entries.ja: 融解、蒸発、または氷山分離によって、氷河や雪原から表面物質が失われる過程。
entries.ko: 빙하나 설원에서 녹거나 증발하거나 빙하가 떨어져 나감으로써 표면 물질이 손실되는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 冰川或雪原通过融化、蒸发或崩解而失去表面物质的过程。
entries.es: El proceso de pérdida de material superficial de un glaciar o campo de nieve por derretimiento, evaporación o desprendimiento.
entries.pt-BR: O processo de perda de material da superfície de uma geleira ou campo de neve por derretimento, evaporação ou desprendimento de blocos de gelo.

entries.ja: すぐには明らかではないかもしれないが、深い影響を与える、重要で広範囲にわたる結果や影響。
entries.ko: 즉시 명확하지는 않지만 깊은 영향을 미칠, 중요하고 광범위한 결과나 영향.
entries.zh-Hans: 可能不会立即显现但将产生深远影响的重大而广泛的后果或作用。
entries.es: Consecuencias o efectos significativos y de gran alcance que pueden no ser inmediatamente obvios, pero que tendrán un impacto profundo.
entries.pt-BR: Consequências ou efeitos significativos e de longo alcance que podem não ser imediatamente óbvios, mas que terão um impacto profundo.

entries.ja: ある活動や社会が依存する基本的なネットワークと施設。
entries.ko: 활동이나 사회가 의존하는 기본적인 네트워크와 시설.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个活动或社会所依赖的基本网络和设施。
entries.es: Las redes y servicios básicos de los que depende una actividad o una sociedad.
entries.pt-BR: As redes e instalações básicas das quais uma atividade ou sociedade depende.

entries.ja: ある行動から生じる、より広範で、時には複雑な結果。
entries.ko: 어떤 행동의 더 넓고 때로는 복잡한 결과.
entries.zh-Hans: 某一行动所产生的更广泛、有时更复杂的后果。
entries.es: Las consecuencias más amplias, a veces complicadas, de una acción.
entries.pt-BR: As consequências mais amplas, às vezes complicadas, de uma ação.

entries.ja: 特に困窮している人々への援助や支援を提供することで、人類の福祉に関心を抱く、またはそれを促進しようとする。
entries.ko: 특히 도움이 필요한 사람들에게 원조와 지원을 제공하여 인간의 복지에 관심을 갖거나 이를 증진시키려는.
entries.zh-Hans: 关注或寻求促进人类福祉，特别是通过向有需要的人提供援助和支持。
entries.es: Preocupado por o buscando promover el bienestar humano, especialmente proporcionando ayuda y apoyo a las personas necesitadas.
entries.pt-BR: Que se preocupa ou procura promover o bem-estar humano, especialmente fornecendo ajuda e apoio a pessoas em necessidade.

entries.ja: 弱体化された、または効果が低下した。
entries.zh-Hans: 被削弱或使其效果降低。

entries.ja: 何かの重要性や意義を強調する。
entries.zh-Hans: 强调某事的重要性或意义。
entries.es: Enfatiza la importancia o el significado de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatiza a importância ou o significado de algo.

entries.ja: 緊急に必要である、または極めて重要である。
氷河や氷床を含む地球の凍結部分に関連する。
entries.ko: 빙하와 빙상을 포함하여 지구의 얼어붙은 부분과 관련된.
entries.zh-Hans: 与地球的冰冻部分（包括冰川和冰盖）相关。
entries.es: Relativo a las partes congeladas de la Tierra, incluyendo glaciares y capas de hielo.
entries.pt-BR: Relativo às partes congeladas da Terra, incluindo geleiras e mantos de gelo.
